scope: every sense authored in tick 1 (shard 10), drawn complete rather than sampled
authoring: parallel family-author agents, one per family, Opus 5 at xhigh, each seeing only its own family's glosses

entries.definition: capable of being reached
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain, unemotional member: reachability stated as a bare fact, with none of the ease that *approachable* grants.

entries.definition: easily approached
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer than *reachable* - the ease reads as a small compliment to the thing reached.
examples: a site approachable from a branch of the Niger

entries.definition: capable of being reached or attained
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A homely, knockabout compound that sounds improvised beside the smooth *accessible*, and stretches past places to things attained.

entries.definition: capable of being reached or attained
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Blunter and more physical than *come-at-able*, its hyphens staging a bit of effort in the getting.

entries.definition: capable of being reached or attained
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The same colloquial compound run into one lump, clumsier on the page than hyphenated *get-at-able* and no different in force.
examples: both oil and coal are there but not in getatable locations

entries.definition: easy to reach
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Openly approving and informal: closeness treated as a convenience worth having, not the neutral fact *accessible* records.
examples: found a handy spot for the can opener

entries.definition: easily approached
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and literal where *approachable* is inviting: it registers the ease and adds nothing to it.

entries.definition: easy to reach
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A measured phrase rather than a word, stating immediate availability with a poise that *handy* cheerfully drops.

entries.definition: acted upon; influenced
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare fact that something landed, carrying no weight and no direction of its own - every other member here adds force to this.

entries.definition: deeply or markedly affected or influenced
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Marks the depth of the effect rather than its direction: where *affected* records that something landed, this records that it landed hard.

entries.definition: (used in combination) affected by something overwhelming
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: A combining form for a blow that lands like a spell rather than a hammer - softer in sound than *stricken*, but no less total in what it takes over.

entries.definition: infatuated with or enthralled by the theater especially the desire to act
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Frames a passion for the theater as an infatuation one is caught by rather than a calling one chooses, which leaves it faintly indulgent.

entries.definition: (used in combination) affected by something overwhelming
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The gravest of the compounding forms, making whatever landed sound like an affliction borne rather than an influence undergone.

entries.definition: (used in combination) affected by something overwhelming
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest of these compounding forms - the blow and nothing more, where *stricken* adds weight and *smitten* adds enchantment.

entries.definition: likely to be affected by something
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names exposure rather than outcome - nothing has landed yet, the thing merely stands open to it, which sets this apart from every struck-and-overcome member here.
examples: the bond is subject to taxation
he is subject to fits of depression

entries.definition: be affected with an indisposition
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Understated almost to gentleness: the illness simply takes hold, with none of the impact that *struck* or *stricken* put into the same event.
examples: couldn't tell when he would be taken drunk

entries.definition: affected by or overcome with wonder
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same helpless blow as *struck*, but what lands is wonder, so being overcome reads as elevation rather than damage.

entries.definition: mentally perceptive and responsive
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the mind as quick on its feet - perception poised to respond, not merely present as in *aware*.

entries.definition: mentally perceptive and responsive
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Casts perceptiveness as vitality, a mind quickened and answering rather than simply watchful.
examples: alive to what is going on

entries.definition: mentally perceptive and responsive
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Frames the perceptive mind as roused and taking things in, with dullness implied as what it has risen out of.
examples: awake to the dangers of her situation
was now awake to the reality of his predicament

entries.definition: (sometimes followed by ‘of’) having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain, unweighted term for holding something in mind, stating the knowing without praising or grading the mind that holds it.
examples: was aware of his opponent's hostility
aware that he had exceeded the speed limit

entries.definition: (sometimes followed by ‘of’) having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The British spelling of *cognizant*, carrying the identical formal stiffness and no extra force.

entries.definition: (sometimes followed by ‘of’) having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and stiff where *aware* is plain, giving the same knowledge an official, almost declarative weight.

entries.definition: (followed by ‘of’) showing realization or recognition of something
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Aims the awareness at a particular thing and marks it as recognized, more deliberate and pointed than bare *aware*.
examples: few voters seem conscious of the issue's importance
the careful tread of one conscious of his alcoholic load

entries.definition: aware intuitively or intellectually of something sensed
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and faintly literary, giving the awareness a felt quality - something registered as much as reasoned.
examples: I am sensible that the mention of such a circumstance may appear trifling
sensible that a good deal more is still to be done

entries.definition: (of weather) free from storm or wind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's plain, unmarked term for weather with the storm taken out of it - it states the condition where *tranquil* admires it.

entries.definition: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Mildly approving: the water is not merely flat but easy, where *smooth* reports nothing beyond the texture of the surface.
examples: a ribbon of sand between the angry sea and the placid bay

entries.definition: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The homeliest word here - heavy waves are simply absent, with none of the admiration *tranquil* adds.
examples: the quiet waters of a lagoon

entries.definition: not changeable
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves steadiness over stretches of time rather than the momentary quiet of *calm*: the weather has stopped shifting.

entries.definition: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A flat physical report on the water's surface - level to the eye and the hull, without the repose *placid* suggests.

entries.definition: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The absolute end of the scale of motion - *smooth* allows a swell that never breaks, this allows nothing moving at all.
examples: scarcely a ripple on the still water

entries.definition: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most admiring member, treating unbroken water as something to be enjoyed rather than merely recorded, which *quiet* does not.
examples: a lake of tranquil blue water reflecting a tranquil blue sky

entries.definition: (of a body of water) free from disturbance by heavy waves
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Built as a negative - not a ripple has been raised - so it carries a faint sense of water that has held its surface, where *smooth* simply describes one.

entries.definition: without or almost without wind
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare measurement of the family, naming the absent air with none of the approval *tranquil* carries, and its own reading admits a near-miss rather than an absolute.
examples: he prefers windless days for playing golf

entries.definition: providing great detail
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal and concrete - the detail arrives as an unbroken sequence with nothing skipped between one step and the next.
examples: a blow-by-blow account of the movie

entries.definition: exercising caution or showing care or attention
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain baseline of the family - it credits the attention without saying how much of it there is.
examples: they were careful when crossing the busy street
be careful to keep her shoes clean
careful of the rights of others

entries.definition: exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Measures the care by its result, enough of it to leave no doubt, where *painstaking* measures the effort instead.
examples: be certain to disconnect the iron when you are through

entries.definition: rigorously attentive; strict and thorough
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Carries a severity the others lack - the attention is strict as well as thorough.
examples: kept a close watch on expenditures

entries.definition: characterized by extreme care and great effort
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Locates the care in the doer's sense of duty rather than in the finished work.
examples: conscientious application to the work at hand

entries.definition: developed or executed with care and in minute detail
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The flat, unshowy member - it credits the fine grain with no suggestion of what producing it cost.

entries.definition: developed or executed with care and in minute detail
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Suggests worked-up intricacy, care that shows on the surface as complexity.
examples: the elaborate register of the inhabitants prevented tax evasion

entries.definition: developed or executed with care and in minute detail
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Participial and cooler than *elaborate* - it marks a thing as having been worked out rather than admiring the result.

entries.definition: characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Pitches the attention at the smallest scale available, finer-grained than *detailed*.
examples: a minute inspection of the grounds

entries.definition: characterized by painstaking care and detailed examination
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the tightness of the field under examination rather than the effort spent, so it approves less openly than *minute*.

entries.definition: excessively or unduly careful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the family's praise inside out - the care is genuine but has run past the point of use.

entries.definition: characterized by extreme care and great effort
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the labour on show - the pains taken are the point, where *conscientious* keeps them inward.

entries.definition: providing specific details or circumstances
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely descriptive - it reports that the specifics are supplied and passes no verdict on the care behind them.
examples: a particular description of the room

entries.definition: characterized by extreme care and great effort
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds a moral edge to the same effort - exactness that would balk at the smallest lapse.

entries.definition: exercising or taking care great enough to bring assurance
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Blunter and more offhand than *certain* for exactly the same assurance.
examples: be sure to lock the doors

entries.definition: excessively or unduly careful
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunter than *overcareful*, with the excess spelled out in plain words rather than folded into a prefix.

entries.definition: unimaginatively conventional
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and needling, making the conventionality sound like a tidy uniform where *conventional* merely states it.

entries.definition: unimaginatively conventional
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same needle with an extra syllable of drawl, drawing the mockery out a beat longer than *button-down*.
examples: a colorful character in the buttoned-down, dull-grey world of business

entries.definition: unimaginatively conventional
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: So understated it can pass for plain description, framing the dullness as caution and letting the sting arrive quietly.

entries.definition: unimaginative and conformist
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flat and unheated, naming the conformity without delivering the disapproval, so the verdict has to be inferred.

entries.definition: rigidly conventional or old-fashioned
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Slangy and dismissive, writing someone off as comically out of step rather than merely dull.

entries.definition: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Damning by diagnosis, treating the sameness as fixed and mechanically repeated rather than just uninspired.

entries.definition: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Drier and more technical, its clinical flatness muting the derision that *stereotypical* carries.

entries.definition: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Everyday and derisive, the predictability sharp enough that the thing is seen coming.

entries.definition: rigidly conventional or old-fashioned
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Flat slang for the same rigidity, labelling rather than jeering, so it lands softer than *square*.

entries.definition: lacking spontaneity or originality or individuality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest naming of the deficit, no slang and no figure, just the absence stated as the fault.

entries.definition: of critical importance and consequence
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Weight without dread: it asserts that the matter carries enormous importance and consequence, where the threatening members add fear to the weight.
examples: an acute (or critical) lack of research funds

entries.definition: being in or verging on a state of crisis or emergency
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Marks the tipping point rather than the harm itself, the moment at which things break one way or the other, cooler and more clinical than *grave*.
examples: an illness at the critical stage

entries.definition: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plainest of the threatening senses, pointing straight at the harm ahead with none of the solemnity *grave* carries.

entries.definition: fraught with extreme danger; nearly hopeless
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Danger with the options gone, adding the collapse of hope that *dangerous* never claims on its own.
examples: on all fronts the Allies were in a desperate situation due to lack of materiel

entries.definition: fraught with extreme danger; nearly hopeless
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Portentous and absolute, pronouncing doom over the situation where *desperate* points instead at the straits of those caught in it.

entries.definition: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Solemn and hushed, registering the threat as something to be met with gravity rather than merely flagged as *dangerous* does.

entries.definition: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most formal and heavily weighted of these, sounding the wound itself as much as the threat of it.

entries.definition: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Literal and clinical, naming outright what stands to be lost where *grave* leaves it implied.

entries.definition: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flattest word here, insisting the threatened harm is real without dramatizing it the way *severe* dramatizes its force.

entries.definition: causing fear or anxiety by threatening great harm
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the emphasis on the magnitude of the harm threatened rather than on the alarm it produces, harsher than *serious*.

entries.definition: having a clean and distinct outline as if precisely cut along the edges
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Credits the outline with the look of deliberate workmanship, where *well-defined* merely reports that the edge holds.

entries.definition: clear and distinct to the senses; easily perceptible
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds tidiness to the sharpness - nothing ragged is left at the edge.
examples: a spire clean-cut against the sky

entries.definition: clear and distinct to the senses; easily perceptible
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Presses on the absence of blur or ambiguity rather than on the fineness of the edge.

entries.definition: clear and distinct to the senses; easily perceptible
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most unmarked term here for being easy to perceive, carrying no metaphor of cutting at all.
examples: the letter brought back a clear image of his grandfather

entries.definition: (of something seen or heard) clearly defined
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Makes definition feel brisk and pleasurable, a freshness *sharp* does not supply.
examples: the crisp snap of dry leaves underfoot

entries.definition: distinctly or sharply outlined
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Elevated and gleaming, making an outline sound not merely distinct but hard and faceted.

entries.definition: showing clearly the outline or profile or boundary
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Neutral and structural - the boundary shows, and the word stops there.
examples: hills defined against the evening sky

entries.definition: easy to perceive; especially clearly outlined
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain baseline of the family: something registers separately, with no claim about how fine or admirable its edge is.
examples: the ship appeared as a distinct silhouette

entries.definition: having a sharp or distinct edge
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Pushes the edge metaphor to an implement, so the distinctness carries a faint menace *sharp* does not.

entries.definition: showing clearly the outline or profile or boundary
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely descriptive of the profile being visible, passing no verdict on how fine or pleasing it is.
examples: the setting sun showed the outlined figure of a man standing on the hill

entries.definition: very clearly delineated
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Superlative - takes delineation to its extreme, next to which *sharp* sounds merely adequate.

entries.definition: (of something seen or heard) clearly defined
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare edge-metaphor for something seen or heard: keenly resolved, with none of the appeal *crisp* adds.
examples: the sharp crack of a twig

entries.definition: having a clean and distinct outline as if precisely cut along the edges
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and almost technical - the boundary is firm, and nothing in the word admires it.

entries.definition: extremely sharp or severe
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Pitches the same pain at severity itself, clinical and absolute where *sharp* only names the edge.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The pain slices rather than punctures - a drawn edge where *stabbing* is a single thrust.

entries.definition: sharp and piercing
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most technical of the extremes, stacking sharpness and penetration together where *piercing* names one alone.

entries.definition: extremely sharp or severe
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Measures the pain by sheer magnitude, dropping the blade image that *acute* keeps beside it.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Fine-edged and literary, the pain thin and bright rather than the brute violence of *stabbing*.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Names the blade outright in plain speech, unbookish where *lancinating* is clinical.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical and cold, the technical term for a tearing blade-pain, stripped of the drama *stabbing* carries.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The participial twin of *lancinate*, same clinical register but with the sensation still running as it is described.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The pain goes through rather than across - penetration where *cutting* draws a line.

entries.definition: (of speech) painful or bitter
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the edge on speech - words that sting and leave bitterness behind, aimed at a person rather than felt in a nerve.

entries.definition: keenly and painfully felt; as if caused by a sharp edge or point
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The bare name for the sensation - an edge felt, with none of the violence *stabbing* adds.

entries.definition: painful as if caused by a sharp instrument
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The most brutal of the blade words: pain delivered as a thrust, sudden and driven in.

entries.definition: possessing an education (especially having more than average knowledge)
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plain baseline of the family, granting the schooling and the better-than-average knowledge that comes with it without the emphasis the others pile on.

entries.definition: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Presents the extensive understanding as something the person actively holds, a state of mind rather than a qualification conferred.

entries.definition: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises the sheer stock of information, workaday and unceremonious where *learned* is solemn.

entries.definition: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The weightiest of them, sounding of deep and sustained study and carrying a faint hush of reverence.

entries.definition: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and faintly ornamental, treating the learning as a distinction worn rather than a fund drawn on.

entries.definition: knowledgeable and educated in one or several fields
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Sets a competence bar rather than a height, a measured claim of command in a field beside the full sweep of *learned*.

entries.definition: educated by your own efforts rather than by formal instruction
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Marks how the education was got rather than how much of it there is, substituting one's own effort for instruction.

entries.definition: literate but poorly informed
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's one put-down, conceding the literacy and pulling the substance out from under it in the same breath - the exact negative of *literate*.

entries.definition: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the weight on the grounding received, crediting the training behind the understanding rather than its range.

entries.definition: highly educated; having extensive information or understanding
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Locates the extensive understanding in books absorbed, claiming breadth of acquaintance where *learned* claims depth.

entries.definition: declared as fact; explicitly stated
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Adds the weight of an announcement standing behind the statement, where *stated* leaves the saying unceremonious.

entries.definition: clearly defined or formulated
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving - the formulation is not merely clear but settled, shaped well enough to stand as the version that counts.

entries.definition: precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The neutral benchmark of the family - it claims clarity so complete that nothing is left for the hearer to infer, without praising or faulting that clarity.

entries.definition: not tacit or implied
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and pointed, marking a thing as spelled out precisely by contrast with what was left tacit.

entries.definition: precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatter than *explicit*: it records that the thing was actually put into words rather than crediting the wording with precision.

entries.definition: describing nudity or sexual activity in graphic detail
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Carries a faint warning in it - the sexual detail is flagged as unsparing, which the colourless *explicit* does not do.

entries.definition: extremely explicit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt and slangy, planting the thing at the far end of the scale where extremity itself is the claim, past *graphic*'s merely detailed.

entries.definition: extremely explicit
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The closed spelling of *hard-core* with no softening of the force - the same blunt assertion that nothing whatever has been held back.

entries.definition: declared as fact; explicitly stated
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plainest way to mark something as asserted in words, carrying none of the formality *declared* brings.

entries.definition: clearly defined or formulated
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Defines by exclusion where *definitive* defines by settlement: the wording is clear because no second reading survives it.
examples: the plain and unequivocal language of the laws

entries.definition: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Carries the ease of the ordinary occasion rather than its regularity, lighter on the tongue than *everyday*.

entries.definition: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The most literal of the routine words here, measuring fitness by the recurring occasion with no suggestion of ease at all.

entries.definition: appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Plain and matter-of-fact, fixing suitability to the routine occasion instead of to a relaxed manner.

entries.definition: very informal and familiar
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Pushes informality into warm closeness, a homely familiarity well past *casual*'s mere ease.

entries.definition: natural and unstudied
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving and chatty - informality as unforced naturalness, praising what is unstudied rather than merely noting what is absent.

entries.definition: not formal
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flat negative of formal, marking the absence and nothing more - no warmth, no reproach, no picture of the occasion.
examples: conservative people unaccustomed to informal dress

entries.definition: without ceremony or formality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The flatter, more clinical twin of *unceremonious*, stating the lack of ceremony without the abrupt edge.

entries.definition: without ceremony or formality
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Frames the informality as ceremony stripped off, with a brusqueness *casual* never carries.

entries.definition: most familiar or renowned
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Superlative but measured, ranking one above all others for familiarity without claiming any grandeur beyond that ranking.
examples: Stevenson's best-known work is probably ‘Treasure Island’

entries.definition: more familiar or renowned than the other of two
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Comparative and narrow, weighing exactly two and awarding the margin rather than any absolute standing like *best-known*.
examples: the better-known book of the two

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Esteem heard as applause, the acclaim voiced aloud where *noted* keeps it under its breath.

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: A literary lift over *famous*, the same esteem sounding sung rather than simply reported.

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The unadorned member, stating full esteem without ceremony, the plain standard *illustrious* and *far-famed* rise above.

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Heightened and balladic, stretching the esteem across distance until it sounds too grand for plain prose.

entries.definition: having the identity known or established
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Coolly procedural, pinning down which thing it is and saying nothing whatever about standing.
examples: the identified bodies were released for burial

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal and lofty, loading the esteem with dignity and splendour that *famous* never claims.

entries.definition: apprehended with certainty
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and bare, asserting certainty about a thing with no admiration attached, the zero point the rest of the family builds on.
examples: the limits of the known world
a musician known throughout the world

entries.definition: so celebrated as to having taken on the nature of a legend
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The extreme of the family, where esteem has swollen past fact into story and outstrips even *illustrious*.
examples: the legendary exploits of the arctic trailblazers

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The faintest esteem in the group, granting that someone is worth remarking on rather than widely admired.

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Dry and restrained, conceding the esteem without raising its voice, next to the applause in *celebrated*.

entries.definition: widely known and spoken of
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Familiarity by constant repetition, the thing quoted as a byword rather than admired as *famous* implies.

entries.definition: widely known and esteemed
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Grand and resonant, the esteem sounding proclaimed rather than merely acknowledged as in *noted*.

entries.definition: widely or fully known
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Broad and flat, measuring how far knowledge reaches while withholding the esteem carried by *famous*.

entries.definition: unerringly accurate
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Absolute and informal, an intensifier of accuracy that allows no margin of error at all, where *precise* still admits degrees.

entries.definition: minutely precise especially in differences in meaning
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of exactness at the smallest scale, the drawing of distinctions almost too slight to mark, without *finespun*'s charge of overdoing it.

entries.definition: developed in excessively fine detail
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Disapproval delivered gently, as an aesthetic complaint: the detail is delicate but spun out finer than the thing can bear.

entries.definition: developed in excessively fine detail
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Blunt dismissal of the same excess *finespun* deprecates, naming it a quarrel over distinctions too small to be worth drawing.

entries.definition: marked by precise accordance with details
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warm praise for care taken over every detail, crediting the attention rather than the rulebook.

entries.definition: extremely precise with great attention to details
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Hyperbolic magnification of *meticulous*, exactness pushed to a scale where the smallest detail is still under the lens.

entries.definition: done with delicacy and skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praise for a fine touch, exactness felt as delicacy of hand rather than accumulated care.
examples: a job requiring nice measurements with a micrometer

entries.definition: being precise with regard to a prescribed or specified criterion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same informal verdict of an exact hit as *on the nose*, with a crisper, more percussive snap to it.
examples: the prediction for snow was right on the button

entries.definition: being precise with regard to a prescribed or specified criterion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Informal and satisfied: a verdict that the thing landed square on the stated mark, not a description of exactness in the abstract.
examples: his guess was on the nose

entries.definition: sharply exact or accurate or delimited
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The family's flat baseline: states that something is exact or sharply bounded, passing no verdict on whether the exactness is welcome.

entries.definition: marked by precise accordance with details
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and stiff, treating exact detail as an observance to be complied with, where *meticulous* treats it as care.
examples: punctilious in his attention to rules of etiquette

entries.definition: precise to a fine degree
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approving of precision arrived at by paring away the coarse, a finished quality rather than an effort under way.
examples: due to the limitations of the available tools, a more refined analysis of the data may be necessary

entries.definition: done with delicacy and skill
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Open, unsubtle praise of the doer's competence, where *nice* praises the fineness of the execution itself.

entries.definition: precisely as stated
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A bare intensifier of identity, insisting the thing is exactly the one stated and carrying no praise or blame with it.

entries.definition: exhibiting native good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Blunt, attributive praise for judgment that owes nothing to training - the compliment is the plainness itself, not the cleverness *intelligent* credits.
examples: commonsense scholarship on the foibles of a genius
unlearned and commonsensical countryfolk were capable of solving problems that beset the more sophisticated

entries.definition: exhibiting native good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The most laboured of the commonsense forms, its stacked suffix making the same praise sound clumsier than the crisp *commonsense*.

entries.definition: exhibiting native good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Carries a faintly wry ring, praising the judgment as homely and obvious rather than admirable.
examples: unlearned and commonsensical countryfolk were capable of solving problems that beset the more sophisticated

entries.definition: exercising or showing good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Casts good judgment as wholesome and robust - a constitution of mind rather than a verdict on one conclusion, warmer and vaguer than *sound*.
examples: the healthy attitude of French laws
healthy relations between labor and management

entries.definition: exercising or showing good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The strongest praise here, crediting the mental power behind the judgment rather than merely certifying that the judgment is good.

entries.definition: exercising or showing good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Identical in force to *levelheaded*, the hyphen giving it a slightly more deliberate, spelled-out look.

entries.definition: exercising or showing good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises judgment for its steadiness under pressure - coolness when things go wrong, which *reasonable* says nothing about.

entries.definition: showing reason or sound judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Mild, floor-setting approval - the judgment clears the bar of sense without being called impressive, where *sound* claims it has no weak point.

entries.definition: showing reason or sound judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Warmer and more practical than *reasonable*, approving judgment for its plain usefulness rather than its defensibility.

entries.definition: exercising or showing good judgment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Flat, unshowy approval - the judgment has no weak point anywhere in it, structural rather than admiring.
examples: a sound approach to the problem
no sound explanation for his decision

entries.definition: based on sound reasoning or evidence
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The coolest, most grudging approval in the set - the reasoning can be held against attack, which is less than saying it is right, where *well-founded* asserts the grounds are solid.

entries.definition: based on sound reasoning or evidence
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approves the base under a claim rather than the mind behind it, vouching for the evidence where *intelligent* vouches for the thinker.

entries.definition: having a higher rank
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Transparent and comparative - it spells out the relation and implies nothing past the position itself.

entries.definition: of the elder of two boys with the same family name
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A bare distinguishing tag between two brothers of one name, separating them rather than raising either.

entries.definition: having precedence (especially because of longer service)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and procedural, framing seniority as a claim to go first rather than as a quality of the person, where *senior* leaves the entitlement unstated.
examples: precedential treatment for senior members of the firm

entries.definition: having a higher rank
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Marks the top of an order and leaves the evaluation out, flatter than *superior*.

entries.definition: older; higher in rank; longer in length of tenure or service
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Bundles age, rank and length of service into one word without choosing among them, so it states standing rather than claiming merit for it.

entries.definition: having a higher rank
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The one word here whose sense of standing above can be heard as standing better, adding a lift that *higher-ranking* refuses.

entries.definition: inferior in rank or status
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A formal grading label, marking the lower step of a paired rank as a matter of classification rather than judgement.

entries.definition: younger; lower in rank; shorter in length of tenure or service
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flatly positional - it fixes someone below on age, rank or length of service without touching their worth.

entries.definition: inferior in rank or status
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Bare comparison, naming where someone sits relative to another with no colour of its own.

entries.definition: inferior in rank or status
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Diminishing - the position is painted as humble and small, so the low standing rubs off onto whoever holds it, which *lower-ranking* never does.

entries.definition: of the younger of two boys with the same family name
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A purely positional tag separating the younger of two boys sharing a family name, carrying no evaluation of either.

entries.definition: inferior in rank or status
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Belittling - the rank is not merely below others but slight enough to seem hardly worth counting.

entries.definition: inferior in rank or status
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Subordination as a question of order rather than standing - it puts something after the first without slighting it.

entries.definition: inferior in rank or status
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Formal and stiff, framing the inferiority as a fixed place in a chain of command rather than a defect in the one placed there.
